scope: Offline tests only; no native observation or gameplay acceptance

contracts.effect_ownership: All exports state unproved ownership, including unique matching windows.
contracts.preexisting_effects: Copied as baseline; duration-only field changes do not count as new casts.
contracts.ambiguity: Repeated matching windows, changed/reused tokens and reappearing tokens remain explicit.
contracts.temporal_resolution: Effect arrivals are sampling intervals, not exact engine delivery ticks.
contracts.phase_markers: Caller-supplied observations only; action IDs do not infer start/release/aura readiness.
contracts.lifecycle: Stop on epoch/clock/party identity change. Controller must supply fresh generation on load.
contracts.failure: Partial native reads cannot seed or advance ledger; budget exhaustion stops without committing partial sample.
contracts.memory: 6 party actors, 4096 effects per sample, 32768 retained effect records, 512 samples, 256 cast windows and 2048 deltas.
contracts.userdata: Only synchronous fresh native references; plain scalar/table snapshots; no saved pointer dereference.

remaining: Native field/API acceptance for this adapter
